If all Φ(x, φ) vanish on D, pair the zero insertion with the reversed adjoint left spectator word to obtain vanishing expectations with x in every slot. Involutivity of J removes the double reversal. The marker criterion above then implies x = 0, proving faithfulness of the prescribed label quotient. For the source lift define the word realization on finite sums by V0(P b cb[b]) = P b cbηb. FR1 proves that its kernel is exactly the word null space and that it is isometric there. It extends to a unitary from HW onto the closed span of the retained chamber limits ηb; no assertion that this span equals a larger chamber is needed here. The word source, its null quotient and the left- concatenation reader therefore recover the Hilbert space and unbounded operators with precisely their actual domain. The operator identity and adjoint pairing are transported on that domain, not inferred from compression of bounded approximants.
